snippet.title: Penguin Cup 2022 |🚨Extended Trailer🚨|  New Club Penguin
snippet.description:
The Penguin Cup is returning for the first time since 2014, just in time for this year’s World Cup! The Sharks won the first time round, but will they win again?

Be sure to join the fun starting on November 20th and score for your team to win the Penguin Cup 2022.
